note: Task import now recognizes the WBS column and rebuilds the outline. When you import tasks from CSV/Excel, the WBS codes are used to nest the tasks: a code like 2.1.1 is placed under 2.1, which sits under 2. Top-level codes (1, 2, 3) stay at the top. Previously every imported task landed flat with no parent. Only the tasks in the file being imported are re-parented; your other tasks are left alone, and the imported WBS numbers are kept.
